1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game – improved graphics with sound
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: 
6: // ---------- Audio Setup ----------
7: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8: function playSound(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.1, volume = 0.1) {
9:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:   osc.type = type;
12:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:   gain.gain.value = volume;
14:   osc.connect(gain);
15:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:   osc.start();
17:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
18: }
19: // Background drone (low volume, repeats)
20: setInterval(() => playSound(60, 'sine', 0.5, 0.02), 5000);
21: 
22: // ---------- Canvas & Background ----------
23: function resize() {
24:   canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
25:   canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
26:   generateStars(); // regenerate starfield on size change
27: }
28: window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
29: resize();
30: 
31: // Starfield background (simple white dots)
32: let stars = [];
33: function generateStars(count = 200) {
34:   stars = [];
35:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
36:     stars.push({
37:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
38:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
39:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
40:     });
41:   }
42: }
43: function drawStars() {
44:   ctx.save();
45:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
46:   for (const s of stars) {
47:     ctx.beginPath();
48:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
49:     ctx.fill();
50:   }
51:   ctx.restore();
52: }
53: 
54: // ---------- Ship ----------
55: const ship = {
56:   x: canvas.width / 2,
57:   y: canvas.height / 2,
58:   radius: 12,
59:   speed: 4,
60:   angle: 0, // radians, used for drawing direction
61: };
62: 
63: // Input handling
64: const keys = {};
65: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
66: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
67: 
68: function updateShip() {
69:   let dx = 0, dy = 0;
70:   if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) dy -= ship.speed;
71:   if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) dy += ship.speed;
72:   if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) dx -= ship.speed;
73:   if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) dx += ship.speed;
74: 
75:   ship.x += dx;
76:   ship.y += dy;
77: 
78:   // Play thrust sound when moving
79:   if (dx !== 0 || dy !== 0) {
80:     playSound(400, 'square', 0.05, 0.05);
81:     ship.angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
82:   }
83: 
84:   // Keep within bounds
85:   ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.radius, ship.x));
86:   ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.radius, ship.y));
87: }
88: 
89: function drawShip() {
90:   ctx.save();
91:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
92:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
93:   ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff'; // bright cyan
94:   ctx.beginPath();
95:   ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
96:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius * 0.7);
97:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius * 0.7);
98:   ctx.closePath();
99:   ctx.fill();
100:   ctx.restore();
101: }
102: 
103: // ---------- Asteroids ----------
104: const asteroids = [];
105: function spawnAsteroid() {
106:   const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
107:   let x, y, vx, vy;
108:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
109:   if (edge === 0) { // top
110:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed;
111:   } else if (edge === 1) { // bottom
112:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + 20; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed;
113:   } else if (edge === 2) { // left
114:     x = -20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
115:   } else { // right
116:     x = canvas.width + 20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed;
117:   }
118:   const rot = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04;
119:   asteroids.push({x, y, vx, vy, radius: 15 + Math.random() * 10, angle: 0, rot});
120: }
121: let spawnTimer = 0;
122: 
123: function updateAsteroids(dt) {
124:   spawnTimer -= dt;
125:   if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
126:     spawnAsteroid();
127:     spawnTimer = 0.5 + Math.random();
128:   }
129:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
130:     const a = asteroids[i];
131:     a.x += a.vx * dt * 60;
132:     a.y += a.vy * dt * 60;
133:     a.angle += a.rot;
134:     if (a.x < -30 || a.x > canvas.width + 30 || a.y < -30 || a.y > canvas.height + 30) {
135:       asteroids.splice(i, 1);
136:     }
137:   }
138: }
139: 
140: function drawAsteroid(a) {
141:   ctx.save();
142:   ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
143:   ctx.rotate(a.angle);
144:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
145:   ctx.beginPath();
146:   const points = 8;
147:   for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
148:     const theta = (i / points) * Math.PI * 2;
149:     const r = a.radius * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
150:     ctx.lineTo(r * Math.cos(theta), r * Math.sin(theta));
151:   }
152:   ctx.closePath();
153:   ctx.fill();
154:   ctx.restore();
155: }
156: 
157: // ---------- Collision & Score ----------
158: function checkCollision() {
159:   for (const a of asteroids) {
160:     const dx = ship.x - a.x;
161:     const dy = ship.y - a.y;
162:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
163:     if (dist < ship.radius + a.radius) {
164:       // explosion sound
165:       playSound(80, 'sawtooth', 0.3, 0.2);
166:       cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
167:       alert('Game Over!');
168:       return true;
169:     }
170:   }
171:   return false;
172: }
173: 
174: let score = 0;
175: function updateScore(dt) {
176:   score += dt;
177:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
178:   ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
179:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 30);
180: }
181: 
182: // ---------- Main Loop ----------
183: let lastTime = 0;
184: let animId;
185: function loop(timestamp) {
186:   const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
187:   lastTime = timestamp;
188: 
189:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
190:   drawStars();
191:   updateShip();
192:   updateAsteroids(dt);
193: 
194:   drawShip();
195:   for (const a of asteroids) {
196:     drawAsteroid(a);
197:   }
198: 
199:   updateScore(dt);
200: 
201:   if (!checkCollision()) {
202:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
203:   }
204: }
205: animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
